en: A black-and-white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a river, showing the large Albrechtsburg castle and the cathedral with tall spires rising behind it. Below the hill are rows of old town houses along the riverbank, and in the foreground a paddle steamer or small ferry moves along the Elbe River. The printed captions at the top identify the place as Meissen on the Elbe and name the Albrechtsburg and the cathedral (Dom).
